summary: Full stack testing of CryptoBot Terminal (paper-trading crypto bot). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases passed via public URL. Verified health/auth-state, PIN unlock (1234 success, 9999 -> 401), auth enforcement on all protected endpoints (401 without X-Session-Token), market/pairs (BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT with price/history/regime), market/{pair} (vwap/bollinger/regime), synthetic orderbook (bids/asks/mid), vault CRUD for binance/coinbase/kraken (encrypted, masked, deleted), strategies CRUD for mean_reversion/trend_following/grid with pause/resume/delete, portfolio aggregation with equity/active_bots/kill_switch/equity_curve, kill-switch toggle, Claude sentiment via Emergent LLM key (score in [-1,1], label in {bullish,bearish,neutral}, confidence in [0,1], drivers array), and trades list. No MongoDB `_id` present in any response. Backend logs show no unhandled exceptions during the full run. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): unlock-screen renders on `/`, entering PIN 1234 navigates to /dashboard, and all four bottom tabs (Dashboard, Bots, Market, Journal) are present and navigable. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: BotEngine._evaluate updates strategy after logging trade; ok, but note buy-then-immediate-close scenarios rely on next tick to reset equity — acceptable for paper trading.
Info: Backend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL naming (Expo public convention) rather than EXPO_BACKEND_URL noted in system prompt; the frontend uses the correct variable, so no functional issue.
Info: Some 404s for static resources (favicon/manifest) appear in Expo web console — cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: Test strategies (TEST_MR_BTC, TEST_TF_ETH, TEST_GRID_SOL) and TEST_* vault keys were created and then cleaned up in the same test run. Pre-existing 'Alpha Bot' strategy remains from prior seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://secure-algo-bot.preview.emergentagent.com; PIN=1234; use X-Session-Token header from /api/auth/unlock. Sentiment endpoint may take up to ~30-60s on first call because it hits Claude via Emergent LLM key; tests use 90s timeout.
